data.title: Head Chef
data.summary: The role leads a small kitchen team producing lunches and catering services. It also involves developing the food offering and supporting business growth.

requirements.text: At least 3 years as a head chef or shift supervisor in Finland
requirements.question: Would someone who has done head chef or shift supervisor work, with fewer than 3 years, be worth a conversation?
requirements.why: The posting requires prior head chef or shift supervisor experience in Finland for a set minimum period.

requirements.text: Ability to independently lead a kitchen and a small team

requirements.question: What does 'passion for hands-on kitchen work' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting emphasises passion for kitchen work and hands-on activity rather than computer-based work.

requirements.text: Skill in making tasty homemade food with fresh ingredients
Developmental leadership and ability to inspire a team
